fp16_rounding.note: bf16 values in the fp16 normal range are exact in fp16; error only below 6.1e-5

activation_absmax.what: absmax over every fixture run (CPU fp32 oracle) of the residual stream: embed_tokens output, layer-0 input (image rows scattered in), each decoder layer output; pos0 = position 0, rest = positions >= 1; and of the MLP down_proj input per layer; fp16 max = 65504
